1.name: Stench
1.desc_en: Adds a 10% chance to flinch the opponent Pokémon to all of the moves used by a Pokémon with this ability that cannot already cause flinching. If a Pokémon with this ability is the first in your belt, decreases the chance of a wild encounter.

2.name: Drizzle
2.desc_en: Summons Rain Dance for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

3.name: Speed Boost
3.desc_en: Raises the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every turn.

4.name: Battle Armor
4.desc_en: Prevents moves from being a critical hit when targetting a Pokémon with this ability.

5.name: Sturdy
5.desc_en: Prevents One-hit KO moves from hitting a Pokémon with this ability. Ensures that a Pokémon with this ability will survive with at least 1 HP if hit at full health.

6.name: Damp
6.desc_en: Prevents the use of Self-Destruct or Explosion, and the effect of Aftermath, as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

7.name: Limber
7.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming Paralyzed.

8.name: Sand Veil
8.desc_en: Raises Evasion of Pokémon with this ability by 20% during Sandstorm.

9.name: Static
9.desc_en: Has a 30% chance to Paralyze a Pokémon every time they use a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

10.name: Volt Absorb
10.desc_en: Heals a Pokémon with this ability for 1/4 of its max HP when hit by an Electric move and nullifies its effect.

11.name: Water Absorb
11.desc_en: Heals a Pokémon with this ability for 1/4 of its max HP when hit by a Water move and nullifies its effect.

12.name: Oblivious
12.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from being Attracted or affected by Captivate or Taunt.

13.name: Cloud Nine
13.desc_en: Prevents weather from having any effect as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

14.name: Compound Eyes
14.desc_en: Raises the accuracy of moves used by a Pokémon with this ability by 30% of their original value.

15.name: Insomnia
15.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from falling Asleep.

16.name: Color Change
16.desc_en: Changes the type of a Pokémon with this ability to that of the last damaging move that hit it.

17.name: Immunity/Pastel Veil
17.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming Poisoned.

18.name: Flash Fire
18.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability immune to Fire moves, and raises the damage of its Fire moves by 50% until it leaves the field when hit by one.

19.name: Shield Dust
19.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability immune to added effects from the opponent Pokémon's attacking moves.

20.name: Own Tempo
20.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming Confused.

21.name: Suction Cups
21.desc_en: Prevents the opponent from forcing a Pokémon with this ability to switch out.

22.name: Intimidate
22.desc_en: Lowers the opponent Pokémon's Attack one stage when a Pokémon with this ability switches in.

23.name: Shadow Tag
23.desc_en: Prevents opponent Pokémon, except for Ghost Pokémon and Pokémon with Shadow Tag themselves, from switching out or running away as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

24.name: Rough Skin
24.desc_en: Damages Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP every time they use a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

25.name: Wonder Guard
25.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability only vulnerable to super-effective attacks.

26.name: Levitate
26.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability immune to Ground moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web, as well as the effect of Arena Trap.

27.name: Effect Spore
27.desc_en: Has a 30% chance to make a Pokémon either Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Asleep every time they use a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

28.name: Synchronize
28.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability becomes Burned, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Badly Poisoned by the opponent, inflicts the same status to the opponent Pokémon.

29.name: Clear Body
29.desc_en: Prevents the stats of a Pokémon with this ability from being lowered by the opponent.

30.name: Natural Cure
30.desc_en: Heals all status conditions of a Pokémon with this ability when it leaves the field.

31.name: Lightning Rod
31.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability draw to itself and be immune to all Electric moves, and raises its Special Attack by one stage every time it is hit by one.

32.name: Serene Grace
32.desc_en: Doubles the chance of an attacking move's added effect occurring when used by a Pokémon with this ability.

33.name: Swift Swim
33.desc_en: Doubles the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability in the Rain.

34.name: Chlorophyll
34.desc_en: Doubles the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability in the Sun.

35.name: Quick Draw
35.desc_en: If a Pokémon with this ability is the first in your belt, doubles the chance of a wild encounter.

36.name: Trace
36.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability copy the ability of the opponent when it enters the field.

37.name: Huge Power
37.desc_en: Doubles the Attack of a Pokémon with this ability.

38.name: Poison Point
38.desc_en: Has a 30% chance to Poison a Pokémon every time they use a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

39.name: Inner Focus
39.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from flinching.

40.name: Magma Armor
40.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming Frozen.

41.name: Water Veil
41.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming Burned.

42.name: Magnet Pull
42.desc_en: Prevents Steel-type opponents, that are not also Ghost-type, from switching out or running away as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

43.name: Soundproof
43.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability immune to Boomburst, Bug Buzz, Chatter, Confide, Disarming Voice, Echoed Voice, Grass Whistle, Growl, Hyper Voice, Metal Sound, Noble Roar, Parting Shot, Perish Song, Relic Song, Roar, Round, Screech, Sing, Snarl, Snore, Supersonic, and Uproar.

44.name: Rain Dish
44.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability regain 1/16 its max HP every turn during Rain Dance.

45.name: Sand Stream
45.desc_en: Summons Sandstorm for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

46.name: Pressure
46.desc_en: Makes opponent Pokémon use 2 PP instead of 1 when they target a Pokémon with this ability.

47.name: Thick Fat
47.desc_en: Halves the damage a Pokémon with this ability receives from Fire and Ice moves.

48.name: Early Bird
48.desc_en: Halves the turns that a Pokémon with this ability spends Asleep, rounded down, including from Rest.

49.name: Flame Body
49.desc_en: Has a 30% chance of Burning a Pokémon every time they use a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

50.name: Unseen Fist
50.desc_en: Allows a Pokémon with this ability to always run from wild battles.

51.name: Keen Eye
51.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from having its Accuracy lowered by the opponent, and ignores the opponent's evasion boosts.

52.name: Hyper Cutter
52.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from having its Attack lowered by the opponent.

53.name: Pickup
53.desc_en: If a Pokémon other than the one with this Ability consumes a held item, lets this Pokémon obtain that item. After battle, a Pokémon with this ability will have a 10% chance to be find an item if it was not already.

54.name: Truant
54.desc_en: Forces a Pokémon with this ability to do nothing every other turn it spends in battle, starting with the second.

55.name: Hustle
55.desc_en: Raises Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 50%, but makes its physical moves have 80% of their usual accuracy. If a Pokémon with this ability is first on your belt, the chance of a wild encounter with higher level Pokémon increases.

56.name: Cute Charm
56.desc_en: Has a 30% chance to make a Pokémon Attracted every time they use a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

57.name: Plus
57.desc_en: Raises the Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% when it is partnered by a Pokémon with Minus.

58.name: Minus
58.desc_en: Raises the Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% when it is partnered by a Pokémon with Plus.

59.name: Forecast
59.desc_en: Makes the type of a Pokémon with this ability change to match the weather: Rain Dance, Sunny Day, or Hail.

60.name: Sticky Hold
60.desc_en: Prevents the item of a Pokémon with this ability from being removed by the opponent. If a Pokémon with this ability is first on your belt, fishing is made easier.

61.name: Shed Skin
61.desc_en: Each turn, has a 1/3 chance of healing all status conditions of a Pokémon with this ability.

62.name: Guts
62.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability has a major status condition, raises its Attack by 50%. Ignores the Attack loss from being Burned.

63.name: Marvel Scale
63.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability has a major status condition, raises its Defense by 50%.

64.name: Liquid Ooze
64.desc_en: When the opponent uses absorption moves on Pokémon with this ability, causes it to lose HP instead of gaining.

65.name: Overgrow
65.desc_en: When the HP of a Pokémon with this ability is 1/3 its max or lower, boosts the power of its Grass moves by 50%.

66.name: Blaze
66.desc_en: When the HP of a Pokémon with this ability is 1/3 its max or lower, boosts the power of its Fire moves by 50%.

67.name: Torrent
67.desc_en: When the HP of a Pokémon with this ability is 1/3 its max or lower, boosts the power of its Water moves by 50%.

68.name: Swarm
68.desc_en: When the HP of a Pokémon with this ability is 1/3 its max or lower, boosts the power of its Bug moves by 50%.

69.name: Rock Head
69.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from taking recoil damage from its own attacks.

70.name: Drought
70.desc_en: Summons Sunny Day for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

71.name: Arena Trap
71.desc_en: Prevents opponent Pokémon, except for Flying-type Pokémon, Ghost-type Pokémon, and Pokémon with Levitate, from running or being switched out as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

72.name: Vital Spirit
72.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming Asleep.

73.name: White Smoke
73.desc_en: Prevents the stats of a Pokémon with this ability from being lowered by the opponent.

74.name: Pure Power
74.desc_en: Doubles the Attack of a Pokémon with this ability.

75.name: Shell Armor
75.desc_en: Prevents moves from being a critical hit when targetting a Pokémon with this ability.

76.name: Air Lock
76.desc_en: Prevents weather from having any effect as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

77.name: Tangled Feet
77.desc_en: Raises Evasion of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% when it is Confused.

78.name: Motor Drive
78.desc_en: Raises Speed of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage when it is hit by an Electric move, and nullifies the effect of that move.

79.name: Rivalry
79.desc_en: Raises the power of moves used by a Pokémon with this ability by 25% when fighting an opponent of the same gender, but lowers them by 25% when fighting an opponent of the opposite gender.

80.name: Steadfast
80.desc_en: Raises Speed of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every time it flinches.

81.name: Snow Cloak
81.desc_en: Raises Evasion of a Pokémon with this ability by 20% during Hail.

82.name: Gluttony
82.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability eat held berries triggered by low HP at 1/2 its max HP rather than 1/4.

83.name: Anger Point
83.desc_en: Raises the Attack of a Pokémon with this ability to its maximum stage when it is hit with a critical hit.

84.name: Unburden
84.desc_en: Doubles the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability when it consumes its held item until it switches out.

85.name: Heatproof
85.desc_en: Halves the damage a Pokémon with this ability takes from Fire moves, and from a Burn.

86.name: Simple
86.desc_en: Doubles the effectiveness of stat changes on a Pokémon with this ability, although the maximum of six is unchanged.

87.name: Dry Skin
87.desc_en: Damages a Pokémon with this ability for 1/8 its max HP per turn during Sunny Day, and heals it by 1/8 its max HP per turn during Rain Dance. Makes a Pokémon with this ability take 25% more damage from Fire attacks, but also makes Water attacks heal it for 1/4 its max HP.

88.name: Download
88.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability enters the field, raises one stage in the Attack stat corresponding to its opponent's weaker Defense stat.

89.name: Iron Fist
89.desc_en: Boosts the power of Bullet Punch, Comet Punch, Dizzy Punch, Drain Punch, Dynamic Punch, Fire Punch, Focus Punch, Hammer Arm, Ice Punch, Mach Punch, Mega Punch, Meteor Mash, Shadow Punch, Sky Uppercut, and Thunder Punch by 20% when used by a Pokémon with this ability.

90.name: Poison Heal
90.desc_en: Heals a Pokémon with this ability by 1/8 its max HP each turn when it is Poisoned or Badly Poisoned.

91.name: Adaptability
91.desc_en: Changes the Same Type Attack Bonus for a Pokémon with this ability from 1.5x to 2x.

92.name: Skill Link
92.desc_en: Ensures that a Pokémon with this ability will always hit five times with 2-to-5-hit moves.

93.name: Hydration
93.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon with this ability of any major status condition during Rain Dance.

94.name: Solar Power
94.desc_en: Damages a Pokémon with this ability for 1/8 its max HP per turn but raises its Special Attack by 50% during Sunny Day.

95.name: Quick Feet
95.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability has a major status condition, raises its Speed by 50%. Ignored the Speed loss from being Paralyzed.

96.name: Normalize
96.desc_en: Changes all moves of a Pokémon with this ability to be Normal-type.

97.name: Sniper
97.desc_en: Boosts the power of critical hits used by a Pokémon with this ability by 50%.

98.name: Magic Guard
98.desc_en: Renders a Pokémon with this ability immune to damage not caused directly by an attack.

99.name: No Guard
99.desc_en: Ensures that all moves used by and on a Pokémon with this ability will hit.

100.name: Stall
100.desc_en: Ensures that a Pokémon with this ability will move last in its priority bracket.

101.name: Technician
101.desc_en: Boosts the power of moves with 60 Base Power or less used by a Pokémon with this ability by 50%.

102.name: Leaf Guard
102.desc_en: Renders a Pokémon with this ability immune to major status conditions during Sunny Day.

103.name: Klutz
103.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability unable to receive the effects of its held item.

104.name: Mold Breaker
104.desc_en: Prevents opponent abilities from hindering moves used by a Pokémon with this ability.

105.name: Super Luck
105.desc_en: Raises the critical hit rate of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage.

106.name: Aftermath
106.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability is fainted by a contact move, damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP.

107.name: Anticipation
107.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability switches in, causes it to shudder if the opponent has any moves that are super-effective on it, or One-hit KO moves.

108.name: Forewarn
108.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability switches in, gives a message warning it of the opponent's attack with the highest Base Power.

109.name: Unaware
109.desc_en: Causes a Pokémon with this ability to ignore all of the opponent's stat changes except for Speed.

110.name: Tinted Lens
110.desc_en: Doubles the power of not very effective attacks used by a Pokémon with this ability.

111.name: Filter
111.desc_en: Lowers the damage a Pokémon with this ability takes from super-effective attacks by 25%.

112.name: Slow Start
112.desc_en: Halves the Attack and Speed of a Pokémon with this ability for the first five turns it is in battle.

113.name: Scrappy
113.desc_en: Allows a Pokémon with this ability to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal and Fighting moves.

114.name: Storm Drain
114.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability draw in and be immune to all Water moves, and raises its Special Attack by one stage every time it is hit by one.

115.name: Ice Body
115.desc_en: Heals a Pokémon with this ability for 1/16 its max HP each turn during Hail.

116.name: Solid Rock
116.desc_en: Lowers the damage a Pokémon with this ability takes from super-effective attacks by 25%.

117.name: Snow Warning
117.desc_en: Summons Hail for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

118.name: Curious Medicine
118.desc_en: Causes a Pokémon with this ability to have a chance to collect Honey after a battle.

119.name: Frisk
119.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability switches in, lets it see what item its opponent is holding.

120.name: Reckless
120.desc_en: Boosts the power of Brave Bird, Double-Edge, Flare Blitz, Head Charge, Head Smash, Hi Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Submission, Take Down, Volt Tackle, Wild Charge and Wood Hammer by 20% when used by a Pokémon with this ability.

121.name: Multitype
121.desc_en: Changes the type of a Pokémon with this ability to match the Plate or Z-Crystal it holds.

122.name: Flower Gift
122.desc_en: During Sunny Day, raises Attack and Special Defense of a Pokémon with this ability and its partners by 50%.

123.name: Bad Dreams
123.desc_en: Causes the opponent Pokémon to lose 1/8 its max HP every turn it is Sleeping as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

124.name: Pickpocket
124.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability is hit by a contact move, lets it steal the opponent's held item if it's not holding one already.

125.name: Sheer Force
125.desc_en: Boosts the power of moves with secondary effects by 30% in exchange for the secondary effect itself, if used by a Pokémon with this ability.

126.name: Contrary
126.desc_en: Reverses all stat changes that take effect on a Pokémon with this ability.

127.name: Unnerve
127.desc_en: Prevents the opponent from consuming held Berries as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

128.name: Defiant
128.desc_en: Raises the Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 2 stages every time the opponent lowers any of its stats.

129.name: Defeatist
129.desc_en: Lowers Attack and Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% while it has 1/2 its max HP or lower.

130.name: Cursed Body
130.desc_en: Has a 30% chance to Disable any attacking move used on a Pokémon with this ability.

131.name: Transistor
131.desc_en: Each turn, has a 30% chance to heal any major status condition from partners adjacent to a Pokémon with this ability.

132.name: Dragon's Maw
132.desc_en: Reduces by 25% damage that partners of a Pokémon with this ability receive.

133.name: Weak Armor
133.desc_en: Lowers Defense of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage and raises its Speed by two stages when it is hit by a physical attack.

134.name: Heavy Metal
134.desc_en: Doubles the weight of a Pokémon with this ability.

135.name: Light Metal
135.desc_en: Halves the weight of a Pokémon with this ability.

136.name: Multiscale
136.desc_en: Halves the damage taken from an attack by a Pokémon with this ability if it has max HP.

137.name: Toxic Boost
137.desc_en: Raises Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% while it is Poisoned.

138.name: Flare Boost
138.desc_en: Raises Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% while it is Burned.

139.name: Harvest
139.desc_en: Each turn, has a 50% chance to regenerate the Berry consumed by a Pokémon with this ability. Chance is 100% during Sunny Day.

140.name: Grim Neigh
140.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability immune to damage from its partners.

141.name: Moody
141.desc_en: Each turn, raises one random stat of a Pokémon with this ability by two stages, and lowers a different random stat by one stage, including Evasion and Accuracy.

142.name: Overcoat
142.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from taking damage from weather effects, and from being affected by Cotton Spore, Poison Powder, Powder, Rage Powder, Sleep Powder, Spore, Stun Spore, and Effect Spore.

143.name: Poison Touch
143.desc_en: Has a 20% chance to Poison the target of a contact move used by a Pokémon with this ability.

144.name: Regenerator
144.desc_en: Recovers up to 1/3 max HP of a Pokémon with this ability when it leaves the field.

145.name: Big Pecks
145.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from having its Defense lowered by the opponent.

146.name: Sand Rush
146.desc_en: Doubles the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability during Sandstorm.

147.name: Wonder Skin
147.desc_en: Lowers the accuracy of any non-attacking move targetting a Pokémon with this ability to 50 if it is higher.

148.name: Analytic
148.desc_en: Boosts the power of all moves used by a Pokémon with this ability by 30% if it attacks after the opponent.

149.name: Illusion
149.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability copy the appearance of the last non-fainted Pokémon in its trainer's party. The effect fades away after the Pokémon is hit by a damaging move.

150.name: Imposter
150.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability transform into the opponent as soon as it enters the field.

151.name: Infiltrator
151.desc_en: Allows a Pokémon with this ability to ignore the effects of the opponent's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist and Substitute when using a move.

152.name: Mummy
152.desc_en: Changes the Ability of any Pokémon attacking with a contact move a Pokémon with this ability to Mummy until it leaves the field.

153.name: Moxie/Chilling Neigh
153.desc_en: Raises the Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every time it knocks out a Pokémon.

154.name: Justified
154.desc_en: Raises the Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every time it is hit by a Dark attack.

155.name: Rattled
155.desc_en: Raises the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every time it is hit by a Bug, Ghost or Dark attack.

156.name: Magic Bounce
156.desc_en: If an opponent targets a Pokémon with this ability with a status, stat altering, immunity removing, or hazard move, Defog, Roar, Whirlwind, or Spite, nullifies that move and instead makes the target use it on the original user.

157.name: Sap Sipper
157.desc_en: Grants a Pokémon with this ability immunity to all Grass moves and raises its Attack by one stage when hit by one.

158.name: Prankster
158.desc_en: Raises priority of all non-attacking moves used by a Pokémon with this ability by 1, however, Dark-type Pokémon are now immune to opposing Pokémon's moves that gain priority due to this ability.

159.name: Sand Force
159.desc_en: Boosts the power of all Ground, Rock and Steel type attacks used by a Pokémon with this ability during Sandstorm.

160.name: Iron Barbs
160.desc_en: Damages the opponent for 1/8 its max HP every time it uses a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

161.name: Zen Mode
161.desc_en: Changes Darmanitan into Zen Mode when it falls under 1/2 max HP.

162.name: Victory Star
162.desc_en: Raises accuracy of all moves used by a Pokémon with this ability and its partners by 10%.

163.name: AsOne
163.desc_en: Prevents opponent abilities from hindering moves used by a Pokémon with this ability.

164.name: Teravolt
164.desc_en: Prevents opponent abilities from hindering moves used by a Pokémon with this ability.

165.name: Aerilate
165.desc_en: Changes all Normal-type moves used by a Pokémon with this Ability to Flying-type, and boosts their power by 20%.

166.name: Aura Break
166.desc_en: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura reduce by 1/4 the power of their respective type as long as a Pokémon with this ability is on the field.

167.name: Cheek Pouch
167.desc_en: Restores the HP of a Pokémon with this ability by 1/3 when it eats a Berry.

168.name: Dark Aura
168.desc_en: Boosts the power of all Dark-type moves used by any Pokémon on the field by 1/3.

169.name: Fairy Aura
169.desc_en: Boosts the power of all Fairy-type moves used by any Pokémon on the field by 1/3.

170.name: Flower Veil
170.desc_en: Prevents the stats of Grass-type partners of a Pokémon with this ability from being lowered by the opponent.

171.name: Fur Coat
171.desc_en: Halves the damage taken from physical moves by a Pokémon with this ability.

172.name: Mega Launcher
172.desc_en: Boosts the power of Aura Sphere, Dark Pulse, Dragon Pulse, Heal Pulse, Origin Pulse, and Water Pulse used by a Pokémon with this ability by 50%.

173.name: Parental Bond
173.desc_en: Allows all attacking moves that strike a single target a single time used by a Pokémon with this ability to strike a second time with halved power.

174.name: Pixilate
174.desc_en: Changes all Normal-type moves used by a Pokémon with this Ability to Fairy-type, and boosts their power by 20%.

175.name: Protean/Libero
175.desc_en: Before a Pokémon with this ability uses any move, changes its type to match the move used.

176.name: Refrigerate
176.desc_en: Changes all Normal-type moves used by a Pokémon with this Ability to Ice-type, and boosts their power by 20%.

177.name: Stance Change
177.desc_en: Changes Aegislash into Blade Forme when it uses any offensive move, and changes Aegislash into Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.

178.name: Strong Jaw
178.desc_en: Boosts the power of Bite, Crunch, Fire Fang, Hyper Fang, Ice Fang, Poison Fang and Thunder Fang used by a Pokémon with this ability by 50%.

179.name: Sweet Veil
179.desc_en: Prevents any Pokémon on the side of a Pokémon with this ability from falling asleep.

180.name: Tough Claws
180.desc_en: Boosts the power of contact moves used by a Pokémon with this ability by 1/3.

181.name: Competitive
181.desc_en: Raises the Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by 2 stages every time the enemy lowers any of its stats.

182.name: Gale Wings
182.desc_en: Raises priority of all Flying-type moves used by a Pokémon with this ability by 1 when the user is at Max HP.

183.name: Gooey
183.desc_en: Lowers the Speed of the opponent every time it uses a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

184.name: Aroma Veil
184.desc_en: Prevents any Pokémon on the side of a Pokémon with this ability from being infatuated, or being under the effect of Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.

185.name: Bulletproof
185.desc_en: Makes a Pokémon with this ability immune to Acid Spray, Aura Sphere, Barrage, Bullet Seed, Egg Bomb, Electro Ball, Energy Ball, Focus Blast, Gyro Ball, Ice Ball, Magnet Bomb, Mist Ball, Mud Bomb, Octazooka, Rock Wrecker, Searing Shot, Seed Bomb, Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Weather Ball, and Zap Cannon.

186.name: Grass Pelt
186.desc_en: Raises the Defense of a Pokémon with this ability by 50% while Grassy Terrain is in effect.

187.name: Magician
187.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this ability uses an attacking move and it is holding no item, steals the opponent's held item.

188.name: Symbiosis
188.desc_en: When a partner of a Pokémon with this ability consumes an item in battle, transfers the item held by the Pokémon with this ability to it.

189.name: Desolate Land
189.desc_en: Summons the extremely harsh sunlight weather condition for as long as a Pokémon with this ability stays on the field. Boosts the power of Fire moves by 50%, and causes Water moves to fail. Prevents the weather from being changed by Rain Dance, Sunny Day, Sandstorm, Hail, Drizzle, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning. Makes all Pokémon immune to being frozen.

190.name: Primordial Sea
190.desc_en: Summons the heavy rain weather condition for as long as a Pokémon with this ability stays on the field. Boosts the power of Water moves by 50%, and causes Fire moves to fail. Prevents the weather from being changed by Rain Dance, Sunny Day, Sandstorm, Hail, Drizzle, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning.

191.name: Delta Stream
191.desc_en: Summons the strong winds weather condition for as long as a Pokémon with this ability stays on the field. Causes moves of a type that is normally super-effective against Flying to only deal normal damage against Flying. Prevents the weather from being changed by Rain Dance, Sunny Day, Sandstorm, Hail, Drizzle, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning.

192.name: Full Metal Body
192.desc_en: Prevents the stats of a Pokémon with this ability from being lowered by the opponent. Cannot be ignored by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, Turboblaze, Moongeist Beam, Sunsteel Strike, or Core Enforcer.

193.name: Shadow Shield
193.desc_en: Reduces the damage taken from an attack by a Pokémon with this ability if it has max HP. Cannot be ignored by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, Turboblaze, Moongeist Beam, Sunsteel Strike, or Core Enforcer.

194.name: Comatose
194.desc_en: Prevents a Pokémon with this ability from becoming afflicted with a status condition other than Sleep.

195.name: Power Construct
195.desc_en: Changes Zygarde 10% or Zygarde 50% into Zygarde Complete when it falls under 1/2 max HP.

196.name: Soul-Heart
196.desc_en: Raises the Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every time a Pokémon on the field is knocked out.

197.name: Stakeout
197.desc_en: Boosts the power of all moves used by a Pokémon with this ability if it attacks an opponent that switched in or entered the field mid-battle.

198.name: Electric Surge
198.desc_en: Summons Electric Terrain for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

199.name: Dazzling
199.desc_en: Prevents opposing Pokémon from using moves with increased priority.

200.name: Berserk
200.desc_en: Raises the Special Attack of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage when it drops below 1/2 max HP.

201.name: Battery
201.desc_en: Boosts the power of allies' special moves.

202.name: Corrosion
202.desc_en: Enables a Pokémon with this ability to poison Steel-type and Poison-type Pokémon.

203.name: Disguise
203.desc_en: Once only, blocks a damaging attack and nullifies its effects.

204.name: Fluffy
204.desc_en: Halves the damage taken from physical moves by a Pokémon with this ability but doubles damage taken from Fire-type attacks.

205.name: Stamina
205.desc_en: Raises Defense of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage when it is hit by an attack.

206.name: Triage
206.desc_en: Raises the priority of HP-restoring moves used by a Pokémon with this ability to the highest level.

207.name: Wimp Out
207.desc_en: Switches out Pokémon with this ability when it drops below 1/2 max HP.

208.name: Dancer
208.desc_en: When another Pokémon uses Dragon Dance, Quiver Dance, Swords Dance, or Teeter Dance, the Pokémon with this ability will immediately use that move as well.

209.name: Shields Down
209.desc_en: Protects from status conditions. Boosts Minior's attacks but lowers defenses and loses immunity from status conditions when it falls under 1/2 max HP.

210.name: Innards Out
210.desc_en: When a Pokémon with this Ability faints, it deals damage to its opponent equal to the amount of HP it had left before last being hit.

211.name: Schooling
211.desc_en: Changes Wishiwashi to School Forme when it has over 1/4 max hp.

212.name: Surge Surfer
212.desc_en: Doubles the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability during Electric Terrain.

213.name: Water Compaction
213.desc_en: When a Pokémon with Water Compaction is hit by a Water-type move, its Defense rises by two stages.

214.name: Queenly Majesty
214.desc_en: Prevents opposing Pokémon from using moves with increased priority.

215.name: Battle Bond
215.desc_en: Transforms Greninja into Ash-Greninja and boosts the power of Water Shuriken when it defeats an opposing Pokémon in battle.

216.name: Receiver/Ball Fetch
216.desc_en: Copies the ability of a defeated partner Pokémon.

217.name: RKS System
217.desc_en: Changes the type of a Pokémon with this ability to match the Memory it holds.

218.name: Psychic Surge
218.desc_en: Summons Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

219.name: Grassy Surge
219.desc_en: Summons Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

220.name: Misty Surge
220.desc_en: Summons Misty Terrain for 5 turns when a Pokémon with this ability enters the field.

221.name: Slush Rush
221.desc_en: Doubles the Speed of a Pokémon with this ability in Hail.

222.name: Emergency Exit
222.desc_en: Switches out Pokémon with this ability when it drops below 1/2 max HP.

223.name: Merciless
223.desc_en: All attacks used on a poisoned Pokémon become Critical Hits.

224.name: Water Bubble
224.desc_en: Halves the damage a Pokémon with this ability receives from Fire moves and prevents the Pokémon from being Burned.

225.name: Steelworker
225.desc_en: Increases the damage of Steel-type moves by 50%.

226.name: Long Reach
226.desc_en: All moves used by a Pokémon with this ability do not make contact.

227.name: Liquid Voice
227.desc_en: All sound-based moves used by a Pokémon with this ability become Water-type moves.

228.name: Galvanize
228.desc_en: Changes all Normal-type moves used by a Pokémon with this Ability to Electric-type, and boosts their power by 20%.

229.name: Tangling Hair
229.desc_en: Lowers the Speed of the opponent every time it uses a contact move on a Pokémon with this ability.

230.name: Power of Alchemy
230.desc_en: Copies the ability of a defeated partner Pokémon.

231.name: Beast Boost
231.desc_en: Raises the currently highest stat (Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed) of a Pokémon with this ability by one stage every time it knocks out a Pokémon.

232.name: Prism Armor
232.desc_en: Lowers the damage a Pokémon with this ability takes from super-effective attacks by 25%. Cannot be ignored by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, Turboblaze, Moongeist Beam, Sunsteel Strike, or Core Enforcer.

233.name: Neuroforce
233.desc_en: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.25x damage.

234.name: IntrepidSword
234.desc_en: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage.

235.name: DauntlessShield
235.desc_en: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage.

236.name: NeutralizingGas
236.desc_en: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in the battle, the effects of all Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

237.name: HungerSwitch
237.desc_en: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.

238.name: Cotton Down
238.desc_en: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

239.name: Propeller Tail
239.desc_en: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves/Abilities that redirect move targets.

240.name: Mirror Armor
240.desc_en: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

241.name: Gulp Missile
241.desc_en: If this Pokemon is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its maximum HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes.

242.name: Stalwart
242.desc_en: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

243.name: Steam Engine
243.desc_en: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by Fire/Water moves.

244.name: Punk Rock
244.desc_en: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

245.name: Sand Spit
245.desc_en: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

246.name: Ice Scales
246.desc_en: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from special moves.

247.name: Ripen
247.desc_en: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

248.name: Ice Face
248.desc_en: If this Pokemon is a Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes will deal 0 damage. Its ice head is then broken, it changes to Noice Form. The ice will be restored when hail is summoned or when the Pokemon is switched in while hail is active.

249.name: Power Spot
249.desc_en: This Pokemon's allies have the base power of their moves multiplied by 1.3.

250.name: Mimicry
250.desc_en: Changes the Pokémon's type depending on the terrain.

251.name: Screen Cleaner
251.desc_en: On switch-in, this Pokémon ends the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil for both the user's and the opposing side.

252.name: Steely Spirit
252.desc_en: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their BP mutiplied by 1.5.

253.name: Perish Body
253.desc_en: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

254.name: Wandering Spirit
254.desc_en: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

255.name: Gorilla Tactics
255.desc_en: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
